<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.5.62</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.62">Released</a> on September 29, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[performance] fix bugs related to load generators @DelusionalOptimist (#4264)</li>
  <li>Bump nokogiri from 1.11.7 to 1.12.5 in /docs @dependabot (#4260)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[UI] Updated the UI of confirmation prompt @Meghana-12 (#4266)</li>
  <li>added maximize and minimize to application @warunicorn19 (#4268)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Added meshkit style errors and comments @Revolyssup (#4263)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@DelusionalOptimist, @Meghana-12, @Revolyssup, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @leecalcote and @warunicorn19</p>
 

   <br/>


        </div>
      </main>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.5.63-rc-1</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.63-rc-1">Released</a> on October 04, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[Performance] Performance REST API migration to GraphQL @bariqhibat (#3960)</li>
  <li>added undefined check in columns @manav1403 (#4284)</li>
  <li>added remote dependency for icon @warunicorn19 (#4282)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Kubernetes as default platform to deploy Meshery @navendu-pottekkat (#4328)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Add unit tests for utils/platform @krithikvaidya (#4134)</li>
  <li>Fix pinning version on latest channel in Docker platform @navendu-pottekkat (#4276)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>changed modal styles to maintain consistency @warunicorn19 (#4316)</li>
  <li>added maximize and minimize to filters @warunicorn19 (#4278)</li>
  <li>[UI] Add smp icon @sudo-NithishKarthik (#4271)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-patterns-filters-applications">🔋 Patterns, Filters, Applications</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Import using url - Patterns and Filters @Meghana-12 (#4212)</li>
  <li>Added support for k8s pattern generation @Revolyssup (#4277)</li>
  <li>use latest version of jsonschema utility in meshery container image @DelusionalOptimist (#4272)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Add unit tests for utils/platform @krithikvaidya (#4134)</li>
  <li>Bump nodemon from 2.0.12 to 2.0.13 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#4294)</li>
  <li>Bump jss from 10.7.1 to 10.8.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#4297)</li>
  <li>Bump glob-parent from 6.0.1 to 6.0.2 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#4293)</li>
  <li>Bump react-redux from 7.2.4 to 7.2.5 in /ui @dependabot (#4299)</li>
  <li>Bump immutable from 4.0.0-rc.14 to 4.0.0-rc.15 in /ui @dependabot (#4302)</li>
  <li>Bump start-server-and-test from 1.13.1 to 1.14.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#4291)</li>
  <li>Bump cypress from 8.3.1 to 8.5.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#4288)</li>
  <li>Bump @cypress/code-coverage from 3.9.10 to 3.9.11 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#4287)</li>
  <li>Bump eslint-plugin-cypress from 2.11.3 to 2.12.1 in /ui @dependabot (#4292)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/meshery/meshery-operator from 0.2.20 to 0.2.21 @dependabot (#4307)</li>
  <li>Bump @cypress/code-coverage from 3.9.10 to 3.9.11 in /ui @dependabot (#4300)</li>
  <li>Bump eslint-plugin-cypress from 2.11.3 to 2.12.1 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#4290)</li>
  <li>Bump eslint-plugin-react from 7.24.0 to 7.26.1 in /ui @dependabot (#4303)</li>
  <li>Bump jss from 10.7.1 to 10.8.0 in /ui @dependabot (#4289)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/prometheus/common from 0.30.0 to 0.31.1 @dependabot (#4311)</li>
  <li>Bump @fortawesome/free-regular-svg-icons from 5.15.3 to 5.15.4 in /ui @dependabot (#4304)</li>
  <li>Bump eslint-plugin-react from 7.25.1 to 7.26.1 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#4296)</li>
  <li>[CI] e2e tests for multiple k8s versions using meshery-smp-action @DelusionalOptimist (#4279)</li>
  <li>use latest version of jsonschema utility in meshery container image @DelusionalOptimist (#4272)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Kubernetes as default platform to deploy Meshery @navendu-pottekkat (#4328)</li>
  <li>Update ROADMAP.md @vedant-kakde (#4286)</li>
  <li>Update perf docs: instructions to download token and update action configuration @navendu-pottekkat (#4281)</li>
  <li>Add instructions for installing Meshery on EKS cluster @alphaX86 (#4090)</li>
  <li>first draft on guide to authenticate @warunicorn19 (#4252)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@DelusionalOptimist, @Meghana-12, @Revolyssup, @adithyaakrishna, @alphaX86, @bariqhibat, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @dhruv0000, @krithikvaidya, @leecalcote, @manav1403, @navendu-pottekkat, @piyushsingariya, @sudo-NithishKarthik, @utkarsh-pro, @vedant-kakde and @warunicorn19</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.5.64-rc-2</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.64-rc-2">Released</a> on October 08, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Migrate from plain manifests to helm charts in mesheryctl @panyuenlau (#4318)</li>
  <li>[Extension] add remote components for changes @bariqhibat (#4317)</li>
  <li>index in spanish page had some words still in englosh @alonsolopezr (#4329)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Testing] Integration Test fail resolved @piyushsingariya (#4335)</li>
  <li>Fix mesheryctl static analysis bugs @navendu-pottekkat (#4330)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump relay-runtime from 11.0.2 to 12.0.0 in /ui @dependabot (#4298)</li>
</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.5.64</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.64">Released</a> on October 06, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Migrate from plain manifests to helm charts in mesheryctl @panyuenlau (#4318)</li>
  <li>[Extension] add remote components for changes @bariqhibat (#4317)</li>
  <li>index in spanish page had some words still in englosh @alonsolopezr (#4329)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Testing] Integration Test fail resolved @piyushsingariya (#4335)</li>
  <li>Fix mesheryctl static analysis bugs @navendu-pottekkat (#4330)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump relay-runtime from 11.0.2 to 12.0.0 in /ui @dependabot (#4298)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-bug-fixes">🐛 Bug Fixes</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Fix mesheryctl static analysis bugs @navendu-pottekkat (#4330)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump relay-runtime from 11.0.2 to 12.0.0 in /ui @dependabot (#4298)</li>
  <li>Update README.md @helloausrine (#4321)</li>
  <li>[Tests] Integration Test fix @piyushsingariya (#4336)</li>
  <li>[Testing] Integration Test fail resolved @piyushsingariya (#4335)</li>
  <li>Bump google.golang.org/grpc from 1.40.0 to 1.41.0 @dependabot (#4306)</li>
  <li>use alpine compatible version of jsonschema util @DelusionalOptimist (#4323)</li>
  <li>Bump billboard.js from 3.1.2 to 3.1.5 in /ui @dependabot (#4295)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[error-codes.md] Add anchors for error codes in documentation @awardnasc (#4331)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@DelusionalOptimist, @alonsolopezr, @awardnasc, @bariqhibat, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @helloausrine, @leecalcote, @navendu-pottekkat, @panyuenlau, @piyushsingariya, @ramrodo and @utkarsh-pro</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.5.65</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.65">Released</a> on October 08, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Fix Pattern Configurator @utkarsh-pro (#4360)</li>
  <li>[Extensions] Change RJSF Appbar position to be sticky in order for it to be maximisable  @sudo-NithishKarthik (#4355)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Fixing <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">system start</code> panic @piyushsingariya (#4357)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump github.com/99designs/gqlgen from 0.13.0 to 0.14.0 @dependabot (#4308)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@dependabot, @dhruv0000, @l5io, @leecalcote, @navendu-pottekkat, @piyushsingariya, @sudo-NithishKarthik, @utkarsh-pro and l5io</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.5.67</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.67">Released</a> on October 19, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[performance] https support and advanced request options for nighthawk @DelusionalOptimist (#4431)</li>
  <li>bug : top link was not working @shubham-tyagi (#4423)</li>
  <li>Add app mesh SVG @utkarsh-pro (#4427)</li>
  <li>[UI] Count displayed when deleted in bulk @Meghana-12 (#4430)</li>
  <li>[Extensions] Remote config addition @Chadha93 (#4420)</li>
  <li>[Extensions] Tooltip style changes @NikhilSharma03 (#4429)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] minor chore update in system errors @piyushsingariya (#4407)</li>
  <li>Fix rubecop constants-in-block @100mik (#4416)</li>
  <li>[meshsync] add namespace for app-mesh @DelusionalOptimist (#4414)</li>
  <li>fix semicolon errors @Shatakshi0805 (#4401)</li>
  <li>Fix JSHint W004 error @100mik (#4402)</li>
  <li>Fix semgrep cookie-missing-httponly error @100mik (#4399)</li>
  <li>UI info display fix @sudhay23 (#4285)</li>
  <li>Add the Database page in spanish @chal-gro (#4379)</li>
  <li>[Extensions] Add maximize and minimize functionality for RJSF Tooltips @sudo-NithishKarthik (#4363)</li>
  <li>fixing the english index page, to avoid showing spanish pages @alonsolopezr (#4383)</li>
  <li>Abishek Kumar’s name is removed from maintainers.md @shubham-tyagi (#4365)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-features">🚀 Features</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Added error states in Grafana metrices @manav1403 (#4361)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Migrate from plain manifests to helm charts for meshery installation @panyuenlau (#4389)</li>
  <li>[Beta] Meshery Adapter for App Mesh @leecalcote (#4448)</li>
  <li>mesheryctl Fix <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">system token create</code> unhelpful error message. @Zanda256 (#4325)</li>
  <li>Add examples for <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> commands @alphaX86 (#4269)</li>
  <li>Added a –set subcommand with the token create command @sayantan1413 (#4249)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Add tests for utils/helpers.go @aayushmau5 (#4177)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Beta] Meshery Adapter for App Mesh @leecalcote (#4448)</li>
  <li>[UI] Count displayed when deleted in bulk @sayantan1413 (#4442)</li>
  <li>[UI] Save Pattern button changed to icon @Meghana-12 (#4432)</li>
  <li>Fixed pattern upload hide feature @vedant-kakde (#4390)</li>
  <li>Added error states in Grafana metrices @manav1403 (#4361)</li>
  <li>Fix JShint W018. Make conditional more legible. @100mik (#4396)</li>
  <li>[UI] changes the color of  “X” from red to the theme color of UI  @Chadha93 (#4315)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-patterns-filters-applications">🔋 Patterns, Filters, Applications</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Change expose service interface in Application @utkarsh-pro (#4428)</li>
  <li>add support for “name” attribute in the patterns @utkarsh-pro (#4419)</li>
  <li>Fixed pattern upload hide feature @vedant-kakde (#4390)</li>
  <li>fix: error uploading patterns to server @Abhishek-kumar09 (#4374)</li>
  <li>seeded applications at startup @Revolyssup (#4362)</li>
  <li>Add support for handling kubernetes components @utkarsh-pro (#4369)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-bug-fixes">🐛 Bug Fixes</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Performance] Add advanced request options fields GraphQL @bariqhibat (#4387)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[CI] added new workflows to automatically label pull request according to file changed. @asubedy (#4256)</li>
  <li>[CI] Token label commenter @Chadha93 (#4358)</li>
  <li>Bump styled-jsx from 3.4.4 to 4.0.1 in /ui @dependabot (#4301)</li>
  <li>Fix bad end alignment @100mik (#4412)</li>
  <li>Fix Rubecop errors @100mik (#4400)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/spf13/viper from 1.8.1 to 1.9.0 @dependabot (#4310)</li>
  <li>Fix Cypress e2e tests and Go unit test @ramrodo (#4332)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Add tests for utils/helpers.go @aayushmau5 (#4177)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[DOC] Add the CI process document of Helm charts of Meshery @Aisuko (#4434)</li>
  <li>Fixed toc.yml URL entries @vedant-kakde (#4437)</li>
  <li>bug pages/guides/infrastructure-management/sample-apps : renamed the online-boutique image @shubham-tyagi (#4436)</li>
  <li>added adapters variable in docs @chetak123 (#4433)</li>
  <li>suggested reading reusable component done @shubham-tyagi (#4338)</li>
  <li>Add examples for <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> commands @alphaX86 (#4269)</li>
  <li>Add the Architecture page in spanish @chal-gro (#4377)</li>
  <li>Add the MeshSync page in spanish @chal-gro (#4380)</li>
  <li>[DOCS] UI Maintainer update  @Chadha93 (#4370)</li>
  <li>Add the Operator page in spanish @chal-gro (#4381)</li>
  <li>updated _data/toc.yml : sub-links in sidebar @shubham-tyagi (#4384)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-security">🔒 Security</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Add safeguard against a decompression bomb @100mik (#4415)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@100mik, @Abhishek-kumar09, @Aisuko, @Chadha93, @DelusionalOptimist, @Meghana-12, @Nikhil-Ladha, @NikhilSharma03, @Revolyssup, @Shatakshi0805, @Zanda256, @aayushmau5, @adithyaakrishna, @alonsolopezr, @alphaX86, @asubedy, @bariqhibat, @chal-gro, @chetak123, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @hexxdump, @leecalcote, @manav1403, @navendu-pottekkat, @panyuenlau, @piyushsingariya, @ramrodo, @sayantan1413, @shubham-tyagi, @sudhay23, @sudo-NithishKarthik, @utkarsh-pro and @vedant-kakde</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.5.68</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.68">Released</a> on November 02, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[extension] endpoint for retrieving extension version @DelusionalOptimist (#4366)</li>
  <li>added abandonment of role @warunicorn19 (#4511)</li>
  <li>[Extension] Meshery sidebar collapse onClick plugin menu item @bariqhibat (#4273)</li>
  <li>[Fix] Download provider package  @utkarsh-pro (#4484)</li>
  <li>[Extensions] Remote config addition @NikhilSharma03 (#4463)</li>
  <li>[UI] Added clear/reset button on profile test @afzal442 (#4404)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Added version validation in channel command @sayantan1413 (#4453)</li>
  <li>[meshery] fixed persisting results SMP @piyushsingariya (#4167)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Fix bug with <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">--view/-v</code> flag and update <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">perf</code> docs @navendu-pottekkat (#4481)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Refactoring of <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesherctl perf</code> @piyushsingariya (#4009)</li>
  <li>Enhance mesheryctl mesh subcommand flags @s1ntaxe770r (#4450)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>fetching PrometheusClient directly from Prometheus API  @manav1403 (#4455)</li>
  <li>[Extension] add remote config @bariqhibat (#4513)</li>
  <li>temporarily removed the connection wizard @warunicorn19 (#4509)</li>
  <li>[meshery] fixed persisting results SMP @piyushsingariya (#4167)</li>
  <li>[UI] MuiDataTable Checkbox color is matched with the theme color @sayantan1413 (#4471)</li>
  <li>added custom color to modal @warunicorn19 (#4469)</li>
  <li>[UI] Improve the Appbar styling of the rfsj component @sayantan1413 (#4466)</li>
  <li>Fix JSHint W032 (Unecessary semicolons) @100mik (#4408)</li>
  <li>Add true random generator. Replace Math.Random() @100mik (#4418)</li>
  <li>Fix JShint W033  @100mik (#4406)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-patterns-filters-applications">🔋 Patterns, Filters, Applications</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Docs] pattern docs update for UI @Chadha93 (#4422)</li>
  <li>[seed content] seed applications into meshery’s container @DelusionalOptimist (#4451)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Rebuild the charts for Meshery and the meshery-operator as the primary chart @Aisuko (#4522)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/meshery/meshsync from 0.1.25 to 0.1.27 @dependabot (#4505)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/meshery/meshery-operator from 0.2.21 to 0.2.22 @dependabot (#4500)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/lib/pq from 1.10.2 to 1.10.3 @dependabot (#4309)</li>
  <li>Bump gorm.io/gorm from 1.21.14 to 1.21.16 @dependabot (#4386)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Refactoring of <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesherctl perf</code> @piyushsingariya (#4009)</li>
  <li>[seed content] seed applications into meshery’s container @DelusionalOptimist (#4451)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Docs] Fixed Functionality button link @vedant-kakde (#4526)</li>
  <li>docs: fix language in concepts @Yiyiyimu (#4516)</li>
  <li>Add guide and docs for <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">system check</code> @alphaX86 (#4462)</li>
  <li>new page : page for listing all the concepts in spanish is added @shubham-tyagi (#4393)</li>
  <li>Updated meshery/docs readme.md @vedant-kakde (#4483)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Fix bug with <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">--view/-v</code> flag and update <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">perf</code> docs @navendu-pottekkat (#4481)</li>
  <li>routing issue is solved @shubham-tyagi (#4476)</li>
  <li>[Docs] Fixed the padding issue in the eks @sayantan1413 (#4472)</li>
  <li>new page : spanish translation of adapters is added @shubham-tyagi (#4395)</li>
  <li>changed eks docs @warunicorn19 (#4468)</li>
  <li>[Docs] pattern docs update for UI @Chadha93 (#4422)</li>
  <li>documentation for app mesh  @Shreyas220 (#4461)</li>
  <li>Move App Mesh adapter to beta (v0.2.2) @buzzsurfr (#4459)</li>
  <li>update docs/_layouts/page.html : removed redundantlinks @shubham-tyagi (#4385)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-security">🔒 Security</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Fix JSHint W032 (Unecessary semicolons) @100mik (#4408)</li>
  <li>Fixed weak random number generator @100mik (#4413)</li>
  <li>Add true random generator. Replace Math.Random() @100mik (#4418)</li>
  <li>Fix JShint W033  @100mik (#4406)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@100mik, @Aisuko, @Chadha93, @DelusionalOptimist, @NikhilSharma03, @Shreyas220, @Yiyiyimu, @adithyaakrishna, @afzal442, @alphaX86, @bariqhibat, @buzzsurfr, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @leecalcote, @manav1403, @navendu-pottekkat, @piyushsingariya, @ramrodo, @s1ntaxe770r, @sayantan1413, @shubham-tyagi, @sudo-NithishKarthik, @utkarsh-pro, @vedant-kakde, @warunicorn19 and l5io</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.5.69</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.69">Released</a> on November 03, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[CI] Set Node version to LTS for docker builds @sudo-NithishKarthik (#4551)</li>

</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.5.70</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.70">Released</a> on November 03, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[mesheryctl] minor changes to installation script @hexxdump (#4544)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[CI] Golang deps: bump up apiserver version @leecalcote (#4555)</li>
  <li>[CI] Golang deps: pinning openapi deps @leecalcote (#4554)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[CI] Golang deps: pinning openapi deps @leecalcote (#4554)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@hexxdump and @leecalcote</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.5.71</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.71">Released</a> on November 05, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>fixed #4571 @Revolyssup (#4572)</li>
  <li>[Broker] add broker url to handler config @bariqhibat (#4545)</li>
  <li>
    <table>
      <tbody>
        <tr>
          <td>[meshery server]Sqlite migration</td>
          <td>CU-1h1xjj2 @Revolyssup (#4333)</td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[UI] Counter in Performance Profile fixed @ruhi09 (#4518)</li>
  <li>Fix issue 4411 (intermittent ci fail on cypress ‘search Cluster Deployment &amp; ping k8s cluster’ integration test) @MarioArriaga92 (#4568)</li>
  <li>[UI] custom table header for selected row @theBeginner86 (#4566)</li>
  <li>Fix JSHint W014 @100mik (#4410)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Fix issue 4411 (intermittent ci fail on cypress ‘search Cluster Deployment &amp; ping k8s cluster’ integration test) @MarioArriaga92 (#4568)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Deprication notice for Kubernetes manifests and update Helm install instructions @navendu-pottekkat (#4514)</li>
  <li>added the same structure for spanish page as it is for english page @shubham-tyagi (#4558)</li>
  <li>Add the Broker page in spanish @chal-gro (#4378)</li>
  <li>Updated the Docs @ruhi09 (#4478)</li>
  <li>Updated Load-generator.md @Rahulkumar2002 (#4548)</li>
  <li>Add earliest supported service mesh version to each adapter @Shreyas220 (#4524)</li>
  <li>fix routing for system redirects @sidecodes (#4564)</li>
  <li>docs: fix language in functionality @sidecodes (#4562)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-security">🔒 Security</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Security] nats-serverv2 CVE-2021-3127 @leecalcote (#4575)</li>
  <li>[Security] opencontainers/runc v1.0.0-rc95 // indirect; CVE-2021-30465 @leecalcote (#4574)</li>
  <li>Fix JSHint W014 @100mik (#4410)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.5.72</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.72">Released</a> on November 14, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Fixed database error on reading performance test @Revolyssup (#4625)</li>
  <li>[Chore] adding go1.16.4 make command @leecalcote (#4583)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[mesheryctl] <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">perf apply</code> add support for overriding values set in the test configuration file with flags @navendu-pottekkat (#4590)</li>
  <li>Fix running tests with saved profile <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl perf apply [profile-name]</code> @piyushsingariya (#4547)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Security] Fix CVE 2020 28469 @s1ntaxe770r (#4588)</li>
  <li>[Security] Fix CVE-2021-29060 @s1ntaxe770r (#4587)</li>
  <li>[SECURTIY] fix GHSA-r628-mhmh-qjhw @s1ntaxe770r (#4591)</li>
  <li>[UI] mapped event_type null to success notification @manav1403 (#4599)</li>
  <li>fix CVE-2021-23440  @s1ntaxe770r (#4585)</li>
  <li>[Dashboard] Fix DB mutex from concurrent read/write and refactoring gql subs @bariqhibat (#4439)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Docs] Add ‘Connecting to Remote Providers’ section in Troubleshooting Guide @gyohuangxin (#4623)</li>
  <li>[Chore] Updating security report mailing list @leecalcote (#4600)</li>
  <li>[docs] note on using meshkit logger and an elaborate example @DelusionalOptimist (#4594)</li>
  <li>[doc] fix routing for command-reference redirects @Et-008 (#4593)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">perf apply</code> add support for overriding values set in the test configuration file with flags @navendu-pottekkat (#4590)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-security">🔒 Security</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Security] Fix “Zip Slip” vulnerability with meshery’s remote provider  @s1ntaxe770r (#4601)</li>
  <li>[Security] Fix CVE 2020 28469 @s1ntaxe770r (#4588)</li>
  <li>[Security] Fix CVE-2021-29060 @s1ntaxe770r (#4587)</li>
  <li>[SECURTIY] fix GHSA-r628-mhmh-qjhw @s1ntaxe770r (#4591)</li>
  <li>[Chore] Updating security report mailing list @leecalcote (#4600)</li>
  <li>fix CVE-2021-23440  @s1ntaxe770r (#4585)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@DelusionalOptimist, @Et-008, @Revolyssup, @bariqhibat, @gyohuangxin, @leecalcote, @manav1403, @navendu-pottekkat, @piyushsingariya, @s1ntaxe770r, @sudo-NithishKarthik, @utkarsh-pro and @warunicorn19</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.6.0-rc-1</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.0-rc-1">Released</a> on November 26, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[bug] fix failing operator installation due to malformed version @DelusionalOptimist (#4668)</li>
  <li>[bugs] fix bugs while unarchiving provider pkg @DelusionalOptimist (#4663)</li>
  <li>[Extension] upgrade meshsync version to match meshery extension @bariqhibat (#4662)</li>
  <li>switch to helm based operator deployments in meshery server @DelusionalOptimist (#4641)</li>
  <li>Updated Meshery Roadmap @vedant-kakde (#4648)</li>
  <li>Add support for Labels and Annotations in Patterns @utkarsh-pro (#4640)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[mesheryctl] <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">system dashboard</code>  @piyushsingariya (#4557)</li>
  <li>refactor: move from io/ioutil to io and os packages @Juneezee (#4653)</li>
  <li>Refine examples in perf commands @alphaX86 (#4628)</li>
  <li>Remove namespace on <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">system stop</code> and add flag to keep the namespace @panyuenlau (#4581)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Fix ‘UI build’ PR workflow job - provider-ui npm ERR! code EBADPLATFORM due to how optional dependencies are resolved in npm v6 @MarioArriaga92 (#4675)</li>
  <li>Fix JSHint errors @Shatakshi0805 (#4424)</li>
  <li>Pattern Configurator: Fix issues with PAtternConfigurator @Abhishek-kumar09 (#4660)</li>
  <li>[UI] Scrollbar styles fix globally @Chadha93 (#4658)</li>
  <li>[UI] Changes in Navigator @manav1403 (#4465)</li>
  <li>[Pattern] New Pattern Configurator UI @Abhishek-kumar09 (#4464)</li>
  <li>[Extensions] smi-icon-extension @Chadha93 (#4646)</li>
  <li>[Extension] add remote config @bariqhibat (#4643)</li>
  <li>[Extensions] Terminal and sessions icon @Chadha93 (#4632)</li>
  <li>initial versioning of docs @warunicorn19 (#4560)</li>
  <li>Bump @fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons from 5.15.3 to 5.15.4 in /ui @dependabot (#4616)</li>
  <li>Bump nodemon from 2.0.13 to 2.0.15 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#4609)</li>
  <li>Bump eslint-plugin-react from 7.26.1 to 7.27.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#4610)</li>
  <li>Bump cypress from 8.5.0 to 9.0.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#4608)</li>
  <li>[Extension] RJSF and Pattern Service Form extension @utkarsh-pro (#4603)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-patterns-filters-applications">🔋 Patterns, Filters, Applications</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Pattern Configurator: Fix issues with PAtternConfigurator @Abhishek-kumar09 (#4660)</li>
  <li>[Pattern] New Pattern Configurator UI @Abhishek-kumar09 (#4464)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>removed extra sleep time from workflow @Revolyssup (#4677)</li>
  <li>fixed invalid yaml @Revolyssup (#4676)</li>
  <li>Workflowforadapters @Revolyssup (#4672)</li>
  <li>Fix ‘UI build’ PR workflow job - provider-ui npm ERR! code EBADPLATFORM due to how optional dependencies are resolved in npm v6 @MarioArriaga92 (#4675)</li>
  <li>fixed failing builds @Revolyssup (#4645)</li>
  <li>Add a flag and make recipe to skip k8s component generation in dev env @Revolyssup (#4626)</li>
  <li>Bump @fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons from 5.15.3 to 5.15.4 in /ui @dependabot (#4616)</li>
  <li>Bump nodemon from 2.0.13 to 2.0.15 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#4609)</li>
  <li>Bump eslint-plugin-react from 7.26.1 to 7.27.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#4610)</li>
  <li>Bump cypress from 8.5.0 to 9.0.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#4608)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Workflowforadapters @Revolyssup (#4672)</li>
  <li>Fix ‘UI build’ PR workflow job - provider-ui npm ERR! code EBADPLATFORM due to how optional dependencies are resolved in npm v6 @MarioArriaga92 (#4675)</li>
  <li>fixed liquid syntax error @warunicorn19 (#4654)</li>
  <li>Fixed broken link @chetak123 (#4650)</li>
  <li>espanol button link fixed and extra code deleted  w/signoff @varunsaral (#4656)</li>
  <li>Add RJSF docs @utkarsh-pro (#4644)</li>
  <li>initial versioning of docs @warunicorn19 (#4560)</li>
  <li>[Docs] Enhance: Warning Section for Replacing logrus @theBeginner86 (#4635)</li>
  <li>Update docs for meshery-smp-action and <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl perf</code> updates @navendu-pottekkat (#4631)</li>
  <li>[Extension] RJSF and Pattern Service Form extension @utkarsh-pro (#4603)</li>
  <li>[Docs] Fix: Display adapters’ earliest version  @theBeginner86 (#4629)</li>
</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>
